overview:
Lakes, palaces and a hill fort in one long weekend: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** Udaipur and Kumbhalgarh group trip starts from Gurugram with an overnight journey in an AC deluxe vehicle. The exact pickup point and time are shared once your booking is confirmed.

Day 1 covers Saheliyon ki Bari, Fateh Sagar Lake and its market. Day 2 is Udaipur sightseeing: Lake Pichola, City Palace, Jagdish Temple and Gangaur Ghat, with an evening at Bagore Ki Haveli or the local flea market. Day 3 visits Kumbhalgarh Fort before the overnight journey back to Gurugram. Transport, 2 nights in a hotel in Udaipur, 2 breakfasts, 2 dinners and a tour curator are included. Prices start at ₹7,499 per person on quad sharing (5% GST extra).
